title: Throw-ins
description: Simple throw-in view showing where the ball lands and how often the move becomes a shot or goal.

team.name: Jönköpings Södra
storylines: Jönköpings Södra took 37% of throw-ins from the attacking third and 27% from the defensive third.
Throw-ins generated 22 shots and 2 goals in the sampled window.
Most throw-ins were retained or recycled safely, with 96% not immediately ending in a shot.

team_attacking_third.title: team attacking third
team_attacking_third.description: Shows where attacking throw-ins usually land and whether they lead to a shot.
reading_guide: Darker areas mean the team lands there often.
Gold circles mean a shot happened soon after the throw-in.
Red stars mean the throw-in sequence ended in a goal.

team_defensive_third.title: team defensive third
team_defensive_third.description: Shows where defensive throw-ins land near the team’s own goal.
reading_guide: The map shows how safely the team handles throw-ins near its own goal.
Gold circles mean the throw-in sequence quickly led to a shot.
